Logins & access 15 accounts

Set these up as you go — your buddy or manager can get you access to any you're missing.

    First week checklist

    Section 09
    Manage the Hub Mgmt
    only

    Keep the Hub up to date without touching any code. Add or update teammates, edit role pages, set the team inbox, and change the new-hire training topics. Need a bigger change? The Site code tab lets an editor adjust styles and behavior. Changes save for everyone right away.

    Management login

    Enter the management passcode to edit the Hub.

    People

    Everyone on Meet the Team. Changes show up on their card, the role pages and the new-hire buddy list.

    Role pages

    Edit what each role page on Roles & Routines says. Who's in each role is set on the People tab.

    Team events

    The recurring meetings, milestones and holidays on the Team Culture calendar. Birthdays, work anniversaries and first days come from People and New Hires automatically.

    Team inbox

    Who owns the team email inbox each weekday (shown at the top of Roles & Routines).

    Standard training topics

    Every new hire automatically gets an open session for each of these. One topic per line.

    Booking links

    Add each person’s booking link and they appear on Meet the Team under Book a meeting, with a button that opens their calendar. Paste the link people use to book them (a Calendly or LeadConnector link, like https://api.leadconnectorhq.com/widget/bookings/name-30min). Add a short note like “30-minute chat” if you want. Leave the link empty and press Save to take someone off the page. People without a link aren’t shown.

    Advisors page passwords

    The Advisors page asks for a password. The onboarding team password opens the Advisor list, Onboarding capacity and Growth (view only). The internal team password opens everything. Anyone unlocked in Admin always has full access. Choose a password, press Save, and share it with that team. Saving a new one signs everyone out of that level.

    Onboarding team

    Internal team

    Passwords are stored scrambled, so nobody can read them back here. If one is forgotten, just set a new one. This keeps the page tidy and out of casual view; it isn’t a bank-grade lock.

    Advisor updates

    The monthly clean-up for everyone at once: set each advisor's billing status for a month, enter the advisor count, and mark the month done. Team members can also edit their own advisors from the Advisors page with each card's Edit button.

    1. Billing status
    2. Advisor count
    3. Finish

    Each advisor's details, hours and billing can also be edited from their card on the Advisors page. Capacity numbers are in the Capacity box there.

    Site code

    Fine-tune how the Hub looks and behaves without rebuilding it. Code saved here is layered on top of the Hub for everyone and takes effect right away. The original Hub underneath is never changed, so you can always clear it and go back.

    Cheat sheet

    How it works. Styles apply instantly to everyone. JavaScript runs once each time someone opens the Hub, so people with it already open need to refresh. Only people with edit access to this page can save; everyone else can read and preview.

    If something breaks. Add ?nocode to the end of the Hub's link to open it without any saved code, then fix or clear it here. You can also press Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K to pause or resume saved code in your own browser, or use Restore previous version, which brings back what was live before your last save.

    Brand colors. Blue #2266FF · Black #212020 · Orange #F75A03 · Purple #7A5FA0. Fonts: Orbitron for headings, Sora for text.

    Handy CSS variables. --accent (blue), --accent-2 (orange), --accent-3 (black), --surface (card background), --ink (main text).

    Page IDs. #panel-team Meet the Team · #panel-role Roles & Routines · #panel-tools Tools & Resources · #panel-training Training Center · #panel-dict Dictionary · #panel-culture Team Culture · #panel-advisors Advisors · #panel-hire New Hire Hub · #panel-admin Admin.

    Style examples.

    /* Make the big page titles orange */
.team-meet-big{ color:#F75A03; }

/* Hide the sticker on one page */
#panel-dict .team-meet-sticker{ display:none; }

    JavaScript examples.

    // Change the browser tab title
document.title = 'AE Digital Hub';

// Change a bit of text on the Dictionary page
var p = document.querySelector('#panel-dict .team-meet-copy p');
if(p) p.textContent = 'Your new description here.';

    Tip: right-click anything on the page and choose Inspect to find its class name or ID.

    Just for you. Your stars are saved on this computer, so nobody else sees this list. Tap a ☆ on any tool to add it here.

    Templates — ad copy, creative, landing pages, emails and reports that are ready to reuse. Copy the text, or open the file. A ★ marks a proven winner, with the test that proved it when there is one.
    Playbooks — what to do when something comes up. Open one, work down the steps, and tick them off as you go (ticks are just for you). See something out of date? Click Edit to fix it, or Delete to remove it, so the next person has it right.
    Testing Library — the tests we run, written up so anyone can see what we tried, why, and how we’ll decide what’s next. Add the results here when a test wraps up.
    Results
